examples.chinese: 你想去哪家餐廳？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xiǎng qù nǎ jiā cāntīng?
examples.english: Which restaurant do you like to go to?

examples.chinese: 你想去哪家餐廳？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xiǎng qù nǎ jiā cāntīng?
examples.english: Which restaurant do you like to go to?

examples.chinese: 這家餐廳賣飲料嗎？
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng mài yǐnliào ma?
examples.english: Does this restaurant sell beverage?

examples.chinese: 這家餐廳的甜點很好吃。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng de tiándiǎn hěn hǎochī.
examples.english: This restaurant has delicious desserts.

examples.chinese: 這家餐廳人太多，我們去那家餐廳，好嗎？他們的牛肉麵很好吃，也很便宜。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng rén tài duō. Wǒmen qù nà jiā cāntīng, hǎo ma? Tāmen de niúròu miàn hěn hǎochī, yě hěn piányi.
examples.english: There are too many people in this restaurant. How about that restaurant? They have delicious beef noodles, and it is also cheap.

examples.chinese: 我朋友說這家餐廳的咖啡很好喝。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ péngyǒu shuō zhè jiā cāntīng de kāfēi hěn hǎohē.
examples.english: My friend said this restaurant’s coffee is good.

examples.chinese: 那家餐廳很近，我們走路去吧！
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā cāntīng hěn jìn, wǒmen zǒulù qù ba!
examples.english: That restaurant is very close; let's walk there!

examples.chinese: 這張地圖上有十多家餐廳，我們要去哪一家？
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhāng dìtú shàng yǒu shí duō jiā cāntīng, wǒmen yào qù nǎ yī jiā?
examples.english: There are more than ten restaurants on this map; which one do we want to go to?

examples.chinese: 這家餐廳很有名，我們常常來這裡吃飯。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng hěn yǒumíng, wǒmen chángcháng lái zhèlǐ chīfàn.
examples.english: This restaurant is very famous; we often come here to eat.

examples.chinese: 這家餐廳賣很多蛋糕和冰淇淋，這樣的甜點我都很喜歡。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng mài hěn duō dàngāo hé bīngqílín, zhèyàng de tiándiǎn wǒ dōu hěn xǐhuan.
examples.english: This restaurant sells many cakes and ice cream; I like desserts like this very much.

examples.chinese: 這家餐廳很特別，沒有菜單。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng hěn tèbié, méiyǒu càidān.
examples.english: This restaurant is very special; it doesn't have a menu.

examples.chinese: 我爸爸是老師，他很喜歡他的工作。他在餐廳工作，每天差不多都晚上十點回家。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bàba shì lǎoshī, tā hěn xǐhuān tā de gōngzuò. Tā zài cāntīng gōngzuò, měitiān chàbuduō dōu wǎnshàng shí diǎn huí jiā.
examples.english: My dad is a teacher; he really likes his job. He works at a restaurant, and he almost always gets home around ten at night every day.

examples.chinese: 我們公司附近有很多餐廳和飲料店。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen gōngsī fùjìn yǒu hěn duō cāntīng hé yǐnliào diàn.
examples.english: Near our company there are many restaurants and beverage shops.

examples.chinese: 你先往左轉，再往右轉，就到那家餐廳了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xiān wǎng zuǒ zhuǎn, zài wǎng yòu zhuǎn, jiù dào nà jiā cāntīng le.
examples.english: First turn left, then turn right, and you'll arrive at that restaurant.

examples.chinese: 他住的那棟大樓附近有學校，也有餐廳。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhù de nà dòng dàlóu fùjìn yǒu xuéxiào, yě yǒu cāntīng.
examples.english: Near the building where he lives there is a school, and also a restaurant.

examples.chinese: 這家餐廳最辣的牛肉麵， 小程挑戰過好幾次，可惜都沒吃完。寫劇本對我來說是個很大的挑戰，但是也能得到不少收穫，所以我願意試試。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng zuì là de niúròumiàn, Xiǎo Chéng tiǎozhàn guò hǎo jǐ cì, kěxī dōu méi chī wán. Xiě jùběn duì wǒ lái shuō shì ge hěn dà de tiǎozhàn, dànshì yě néng dédào bùshǎo shōuhuò, suǒyǐ wǒ yuànyì shìshi.
examples.english: Xiao Cheng has challenged the spiciest beef noodles at this restaurant several times, but unfortunately he never finished them. Writing scripts is a big challenge for me, but I can also gain a lot from it, so I am willing to give it a try.

examples.chinese: 這家餐廳不僅服務態度好，而且食物好吃又便宜，難怪大家都推薦我來嚐嚐。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng bùjǐn fúwù tàidù hǎo, érqiě shíwù hǎochī yòu piányi, nánguài dàjiā dōu tuījiàn wǒ lái chángchang.
examples.english: This restaurant not only has a good service attitude, but the food is also delicious and cheap; no wonder everyone recommended I come and try it.

examples.chinese: 我和朋友到餐廳點了好多菜，最後沒吃完，只好打包回家。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hé péngyou dào cāntīng diǎn le hǎo duō cài, zuìhòu méi chī wán, zhǐhǎo dǎbāo huí jiā.
examples.english: My friend and I went to a restaurant and ordered a lot of dishes. In the end, we couldn't finish them, so we had to pack them to take home.

examples.chinese: 在這家餐廳吃飯，要是滿兩千元，老闆就免費招待一盤炒青菜。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhè jiā cāntīng chīfàn, yàoshi mǎn liǎngqiān yuán, lǎobǎn jiù miǎnfèi zhāodài yī pán chǎo qīngcài.
examples.english: If you spend at least two thousand dollars at this restaurant, the owner will treat you to a free plate of stir-fried greens.

examples.chinese: 那家動物餐廳的空間很大，可以讓客人的小動物自由自在地活動。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā dòngwù cāntīng de kōngjiān hěn dà, kěyǐ ràng kèrén de xiǎo dòngwù zìyóuzìzài de huódòng.
examples.english: That animal restaurant has a lot of space, allowing guests' small pets to move around freely and fancy-free.

examples.chinese: 這棟商業大樓的規模很大，除了有很多商店、餐廳，還有電影院、健身房。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dòng shāngyè dàlóu de guīmó hěn dà, chúle yǒu hěn duō shāngdiàn, cāntīng, hái yǒu diànyǐngyuàn, jiànshēnfáng.
examples.english: The scale of this commercial building is very large; besides many shops and restaurants, there are also a movie theater and a gym.

examples.chinese: 這家餐廳的菜不僅平價，還很營養，常常中午十二點前舉客滿了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng de cài bùjǐn píngjià, hái hěn yíngyǎng, chángcháng zhōngwǔ shí'èr diǎn qián jiù kèmǎn le.
examples.english: This restaurant's dishes are not only affordable but also very nutritious; it is often full before 12 noon.

examples.chinese: 學生與校長當面對話，希望學校改善教學設備和校園餐廳的服務品質。聽到老闆跟經理的對話，我才知道公司新產品的銷售成績不理想。
examples.pinyin: Xuéshēng yǔ xiàozhǎng dāngmiàn duìhuà, xīwàng xuéxiào gǎishàn jiàoxué shèbèi hé xiàoyuán cāntīng de fúwù pǐnzhí. Tīngdào lǎobǎn gēn jīnglǐ de duìhuà, wǒ cái zhīdào gōngsī xīn chǎnpǐn de xiāoshòu chéngjì bù lǐxiǎng.
examples.english: Students had a face-to-face dialogue with the principal, hoping the school would improve teaching equipment and the service quality of the campus cafeteria. Only after hearing the dialogue between the boss and the manager did I realize that the sales performance of the company's new product was not ideal.

examples.chinese: 我打工的餐廳一到週末就客滿，忙不過來的時候，連老闆的叔叔都得來幫忙。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ dǎgōng de cāntīng yí dào zhōumò jiù kèmǎn, máng bú guòlái de shíhou, lián lǎobǎn de shūshu dōu děi lái bāngmáng.
examples.english: The restaurant where I work part-time is full every weekend; when they are too busy to manage, even the boss's uncle has to come help.

examples.chinese: 古先生很重視環保，購物時會準備環保袋，在餐廳吃飯也會用環保筷。
examples.pinyin: Gǔ xiānsheng hěn zhòngshì huánbǎo, gòuwù shí huì zhǔnbèi huánbǎo dài, zài cāntīng chīfàn yě huì yòng huánbǎo kuài.
examples.english: Mr. Gu attaches great importance to environmental protection; when shopping he prepares eco-friendly bags, and when eating in restaurants he also uses eco-friendly chopsticks.

examples.chinese: 為了保護我們愛的人，我們得勇敢一點兒。
examples.pinyin: Wèile bǎohù wǒmen ài de rén, wǒmen děi yǒnggǎn yīdiǎnr.
examples.english: In order to protect the people we love, we must be a bit braver.

examples.chinese: 陳可欣是一個勇敢、樂觀的人，什麼麻煩、困難的問題都不怕。
examples.pinyin: Chén Kěxīn shì yí ge yǒnggǎn, lèguān de rén, shénme máfan, kùnnan de wèntí dōu bú pà.
examples.english: Chen Kexin is a brave and optimistic person; she is not afraid of any troublesome or difficult problems.

examples.chinese: 他很勇敢，十五歲就離開父母，一個人到英國去留學了。
examples.pinyin: Tā hěn yǒnggǎn, shíwǔ suì jiù líkāi fùmǔ, yí ge rén dào Yīngguó qù liúxué le.
examples.english: He is very brave; at fifteen he left his parents and went to England alone to study abroad.

examples.chinese: 那個孩子可真勇敢！連看到蛇也不害怕。
examples.pinyin: Nàge háizi kě zhēn yǒnggǎn! Lián kàn dào shé yě bú hàipà.
examples.english: That child is certainly brave! He is not even afraid when he sees a snake.

examples.chinese: 小鐘昨天晚上做了好幾個夢，沒睡好，難怪今天精神很不好。有人說，有夢最美。應該趁著年輕勇敢地做夢，更要努力讓夢想變成真的。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Zhōng zuótiān wǎnshang zuò le hǎo jǐ ge mèng, méi shuì hǎo, nánguài jīntiān jīngshén hěn bù hǎo. Yǒu rén shuō, yǒu mèng zuì měi. Yīnggāi chènzhe niánqīng yǒnggǎn de zuòmèng, gèng yào nǔlì ràng mèngxiǎng biànchéng zhēn de.
examples.english: Xiao Zhong had several dreams last night and didn't sleep well; no wonder he is in very low spirits today. Some people say that having dreams is the most beautiful thing. You should bravely dream while you are young, and even more, work hard to make your dreams come true.

examples.chinese: 小明從小就很勇敢，希望長大後能當一名好警察。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎomíng cóngxiǎo jiù hěn yǒnggǎn, xīwàng zhǎngdà hòu néng dāng yī míng hǎo jǐngchá.
examples.english: Xiaoming has been brave since childhood, and he hopes that when he grows up he can become a good police officer.

examples.chinese: 他是一個誠實的孩子，做錯事一定會勇敢承認的。
examples.pinyin: Tā shì yī ge chéngshí de háizi, zuò cuò shì yīdìng huì yǒnggǎn chéngrèn de.
examples.english: He is an honest child; if he does something wrong, he will definitely bravely admit it.

examples.chinese: 你聽了尤老闆勇敢克服困難、堅持到底的真實故事，有什麼感想？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ tīng le Yóu lǎobǎn yǒnggǎn kèfú kùnnan, jiānchí dàodǐ de zhēnshí gùshi, yǒu shénme gǎnxiǎng?
examples.english: After hearing Boss You's true story of bravely overcoming difficulties and persevering to the end, what are your thoughts?

examples.chinese: 生命就像海洋一樣，只有勇敢的人們才能抵達海的另一邊。
examples.pinyin: Shēngmìng jiù xiàng hǎiyáng yíyàng, zhǐyǒu yǒnggǎn de rénmen cái néng dǐdá hǎi de lìng yì biān.
examples.english: Life is like the ocean; only brave people can reach the other side of the sea.

examples.chinese: 只有勇敢面對挑戰、克服困難的人，才能深深體會到成就感帶來的快樂。
examples.pinyin: Zhǐyǒu yǒnggǎn miànduì tiǎozhàn, kèfú kùnnán de rén, cái néng shēnshēn tǐhuì dào chéngjiùgǎn dàilái de kuàilè.
examples.english: Only those who bravely face challenges and overcome difficulties can deeply experience the happiness that a sense of accomplishment brings.

examples.chinese: 他非常不愛惜自己的東西，所以東西常不見。
examples.pinyin: Tā fēicháng bù àixī zìjǐ de dōngxi, suǒyǐ dōngxi cháng bùjiàn.
examples.english: He doesn't cherish his own things at all, so his things often go missing.

examples.chinese: 他很愛惜東西，所以東西都能用很久，省了不少錢。
examples.pinyin: Tā hěn àixī dōngxi, suǒyǐ dōngxi dōu néng yòng hěn jiǔ, shěng le bùshǎo qián.
examples.english: He really cherishes things, so things can all be used for a long time, and he has saved quite a bit of money.

examples.chinese: 為了愛惜食物資源，同時也幫助生活困難的家庭，張老闆決定在國內開幾家食物銀行。
examples.pinyin: Wèile àixī shíwù zīyuán, tóngshí yě bāngzhù shēnghuó kùnnán de jiātíng, Zhāng lǎobǎn juédìng zài guónèi kāi jǐ jiā shíwù yínháng.
examples.english: In order to cherish food resources and at the same time help families with financial difficulties, Boss Zhang decided to open several food banks in the country.

examples.chinese: 我們不能因為自來水很方便，就不愛惜水資源。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen bùnéng yīnwèi zìláishuǐ hěn fāngbiàn, jiù bù àixī shuǐ zīyuán.
examples.english: We shouldn't fail to cherish water resources just because tap water is very convenient.

examples.chinese: 曾經失去一切的人，更懂得愛惜現在擁有的一切。
examples.pinyin: Céngjīng shīqù yíqiè de rén, gèng dǒngde àixī xiànzài yōngyǒu de yíqiè.
examples.english: People who have once lost everything understand even more how to cherish everything they have now.

examples.chinese: 要是你想知道山區天氣的情況，上網看看氣象預報就行了。
examples.pinyin: Yàoshi nǐ xiǎng zhīdào shānqū tiānqì de qíngkuàng, shàngwǎng kànkan qìxiàng yùbào jiù xíng le.
examples.english: If you want to know the weather conditions in the mountains, just go online and check the weather forecast.

examples.chinese: 氣象預報說，從明天起一連三天，中部以北地氣溫只有十五度，出門時最好加件外套。
examples.pinyin: Qìxiàng yùbào shuō, cóng míngtiān qǐ yīlián sān tiān, zhōngbù yǐběi dìqū qìwēn zhǐyǒu shíwǔ dù, chūmén shí zuìhǎo jiā jiàn wàitào.
examples.english: The weather forecast says that starting tomorrow for three days in a row, the temperature in the central and northern regions will be only 15 degrees; when going out, it's best to add a jacket.

examples.chinese: 氣象預報人員確定明天颱風會來，我們最好去吃超市買一些泡麵、雞蛋。老闆要我照確定的日期去南部出差，如果有什麼改變，他會早點兒通知我。
examples.pinyin: Qìxiàng yùbào rényuán quèdìng míngtiān táifēng huì lái, wǒmen zuìhǎo qù chāoshì mǎi yìxiē pàomiàn, jīdàn. Lǎobǎn yào wǒ zhào quèdìng de rìqī qù nánbù chūchāi, rúguǒ yǒu shénme gǎibiàn, tā huì zǎodiǎnr tōngzhī wǒ.
examples.english: The weather forecasters are sure that the typhoon will come tomorrow; we'd better go to the supermarket to buy some instant noodles and eggs. The boss wants me to go on a business trip to the south according to the confirmed date; if there are any changes, he will notify me earlier.

items.wordHook: Combining 預(prepare) and 報(announce): 預報 means forecast.

examples.chinese: 在國外留學的時候，小史是我最好的兄弟，我們總是互相照顧、互相幫忙。
examples.pinyin: Zài guówài liúxué de shíhou, Xiǎo Shǐ shì wǒ zuì hǎo de xiōngdì, wǒmen zǒngshì hùxiāng zhàogù, hùxiāng bāngmáng.
examples.english: When I was studying abroad, Xiao Shi was my best brother; we always took care of each other and helped each other.

items.wordHook: Combining 兄(elder brother) and 弟(young brother): 兄弟 means brother.

examples.chinese: 林伯伯覺得最近身體的毛病不少，可是說也奇怪，醫生檢查後都說他很正常。
examples.pinyin: Lín bóbo juéde zuìjìn shēntǐ de máobìng bù shǎo, kěshì shuō yě qíguài, yīshēng jiǎnchá hòu dōu shuō tā hěn zhèngcháng.
examples.english: Uncle Lin feels that he has quite a few health problems recently, but strange to say, after the doctor's examination, they all say he is very normal.

examples.chinese: 公司向每位員工發出健檢通知，上面寫著檢查時間、地點和需要注意的事情。地震救災人員聽到東邊大約五公尺以外的地方，有人發出求救的聲音，就立刻趕過去救人。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī xiàng měi wèi yuángōng fāchū jiànjiǎn tōngzhī, shàngmiàn xiě zhe jiǎnchá shíjiān, dìdiǎn hé xūyào zhùyì de shìqíng. Dìzhèn jiùzāi rényuán tīngdào dōngbiān dàyuē wǔ gōngchǐ yǐwài de dìfāng, yǒu rén fāchū qiújiù de shēngyīn, jiù lìkè gǎn guòqù jiù rén.
examples.english: The company sent out a health check notice to every employee, with the examination time, location, and matters needing attention written on it. Earthquake rescue workers heard someone send out a cry for help from a place about five meters to the east, so they immediately rushed over to rescue the person.

examples.chinese: A:醫生，我求你快救救我的貓。 B:別急！我馬上檢查。
examples.pinyin: A: Yīshēng, wǒ qiú nǐ kuài jiùjiu wǒ de māo. B: Bié jí! Wǒ mǎshàng jiǎnchá.
examples.english: A: Doctor, I beg you to save my cat quickly. B: Don't worry! I'll examine it right away.

examples.chinese: 每次出國時，機場的安全人員都會檢查我們的護照和行李。
examples.pinyin: Měi cì chūguó shí, jīchǎng de ānquán rényuán dōu huì jiǎnchá wǒmen de hùzhào hé xíngli.
examples.english: Every time we go abroad, the airport security staff check our passports and luggage.

examples.chinese: 那班飛機因為天氣的關係，沒辦法準時抵達。總統抵達新聞說明會的現場前，安全人員得先確認記者的資料，還得檢查他們的背包。
examples.pinyin: Nà bān fēijī yīnwèi tiānqì de guānxi, méi bànfǎ zhǔnshí dǐdá. Zǒngtǒng dǐdá xīnwén shuōmínghuì de xiànchǎng qián, ānquán rényuán děi xiān quèrèn jìzhě de zīliào, hái děi jiǎnchá tāmen de bēibāo.
examples.english: That flight could not arrive on time because of the weather. Before the president arrived at the press conference site, security personnel had to first confirm the reporters' information and also check their backpacks.

examples.chinese: 史小姐做事很細心，這張表我檢查過好幾次，還是被她發現了幾個錯字。
examples.pinyin: Shǐ xiǎojiě zuòshì hěn xìxīn, zhè zhāng biǎo wǒ jiǎnchá guo hǎojǐ cì, háishi bèi tā fāxiàn le jǐ ge cuòzì.
examples.english: Ms. Shi is very careful in her work; I checked this form several times, but she still found a few typos.

examples.chinese: 我每次寫完考卷都會仔細檢查一遍，要是發現錯誤就馬上改過來。費太太結婚後才發現這是個錯誤決定，她不知道該怎麼辦才好。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ měi cì xiě wán kǎojuàn dōu huì zǐxì jiǎnchá yí biàn, yàoshi fāxiàn cuòwù jiù mǎshàng gǎi guòlái. Fèi tàitai jiéhūn hòu cái fāxiàn zhè shì ge cuòwù juédìng, tā bù zhīdào gāi zěnme bàn cái hǎo.
examples.english: Every time I finish writing an exam paper, I carefully check it once; if I find a mistake, I immediately correct it. Mrs. Fei only discovered after marriage that this was a wrong decision, and she doesn't know what to do.

examples.chinese: 過海關時，請配合相關人員檢查行李。
examples.pinyin: Guò hǎiguān shí, qǐng pèihé xiāngguān rényuán jiǎnchá xínglǐ.
examples.english: When going through customs, please cooperate with the relevant personnel in inspecting your luggage.

examples.chinese: 我每天騎車上班前，總是習慣先檢查摩托車的輪子正不正常。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ měi tiān qí chē shàngbān qián, zǒngshì xíguàn xiān jiǎnchá mótuōchē de lúnzi zhèng bù zhèngcháng.
examples.english: Before I ride my bike to work every day, I always habitually first check whether the motorcycle's tires are normal.

examples.chinese: 你帶著邀請卡給門口的服務人員檢查，才能入場參加活動。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ dài zhe yāoqǐngkǎ gěi ménkǒu de fúwù rényuán jiǎnchá, cái néng rùchǎng cānjiā huódòng.
examples.english: You bring your invitation card for the service staff at the entrance to check, and only then can you enter the venue to participate in the event.

examples.chinese: 你來得正好，請你幫我檢查這些文件，我一個人實在做不來。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ lái de zhènghǎo, qǐng nǐ bāng wǒ jiǎnchá zhèxiē wénjiàn, wǒ yí ge rén shízài zuò bù lái.
examples.english: You've come at just the right time; please help me check these documents—I really can't do it alone.

examples.chinese: 為了旅客搭機安全，機場入境、出境時都要檢查行李。
examples.pinyin: Wèi le lǚkè dā jī ānquán, jīchǎng rùjìng, chūjìng shí dōu yào jiǎnchá xínglǐ.
examples.english: For passenger flight safety, luggage must be checked when entering and leaving the country at the airport.

examples.chinese: 我的電腦無法上網，檢查之後才發現網路線沒有接著電腦。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de diànnǎo wúfǎ shàngwǎng, jiǎnchá zhīhòu cái fāxiàn wǎnglùxiàn méiyǒu jiēzhe diànnǎo.
examples.english: My computer can't get online; only after checking did I discover that the network cable was not connected to the computer.

examples.chinese: 肚子痛有時不一定是消化器官的問題，得去醫院檢查。
examples.pinyin: Dùzi tòng yǒushí bù yídìng shì xiāohuà qìguān de wèntí, děi qù yīyuàn jiǎnchá.
examples.english: A stomachache is sometimes not necessarily a problem with the digestive organs; you need to go to the hospital for an examination.

examples.chinese: 醫師要我到廁所大便，再拿一點兒放在盒子送去檢查。
examples.pinyin: Yīshī yào wǒ dào cèsuǒ dàbiàn, zài ná yīdiǎnr fàng zài hézi lǐ sòng qù jiǎnchá.
examples.english: The doctor asked me to go to the restroom to defecate, then take a little and put it in a box to send for testing.

examples.chinese: 有些病頭幾個月的症狀不明顯，得做進一步的檢查才能確定。
examples.pinyin: Yǒuxiē bìng tóu jǐ gè yuè de zhèngzhuàng bù míngxiǎn, děi zuò jìnyībù de jiǎnchá cái néng quèdìng.
examples.english: For some diseases, the symptoms in the first few months are not obvious; further examination is needed to confirm.

examples.chinese: 經過血液檢查，人們就可以知道自己的血型。
examples.pinyin: Jīngguò xuèyè jiǎnchá, rénmen jiù kěyǐ zhīdào zìjǐ de xuèxíng.
examples.english: Through a blood test, people can know their own blood type.

examples.chinese: 要是病人頭很暈又有發燒症狀時，就必須立刻送醫院檢查。
examples.pinyin: Yàoshi bìngrén tóu hěn yūn yòu yǒu fāshāo zhèngzhuàng shí, jiù bìxū lìkè sòng yīyuàn jiǎnchá.
examples.english: If a patient is very dizzy and also has fever symptoms, they must be sent to the hospital for examination immediately.

items.wordHook: Combining 檢(check) and 查(investigate): 檢查 means examination.

examples.chinese: 陳先生身體一向挺健康的，沒想到一個小感冒就讓他病了一個多月。
examples.pinyin: Chén xiānshēng shēntǐ yīxiàng tǐng jiànkāng de, méi xiǎngdào yī gè xiǎo gǎnmào jiù ràng tā bìng le yī gè duō yuè.
examples.english: Mr. Chen has always been quite healthy; I never expected that a small cold would make him fall ill for over a month.

examples.chinese: 林伯伯覺得最近身體的毛病不少，可是說也奇怪，醫生檢查後都說他很正常。
examples.pinyin: Lín bóbo juéde zuìjìn shēntǐ de máobìng bù shǎo, kěshì shuō yě qíguài, yīshēng jiǎnchá hòu dōu shuō tā hěn zhèngcháng.
examples.english: Uncle Lin feels that he has quite a few health problems recently, but strange to say, after the doctor's examination, they all say he is very normal.

examples.chinese: A:小張病了三天了，不但全身沒力，還發高燒。 B:最近很多人都這樣，應該是感冒了。
examples.pinyin: A: Xiǎo Zhāng bìng le sān tiān le, bùdàn quánshēn méi lì, hái fā gāoshāo. B: Zuìjìn hěn duō rén dōu zhèyàng, yīnggāi shì gǎnmào le.
examples.english: A: Xiao Zhang has been ill for three days; not only does his whole body have no strength, but he also has a high fever. B: Many people have been like this recently; it's probably a cold.

examples.chinese: 我爺爺年紀大了，不但體力不好，還有頭痛、肩膀痛的毛病。我家的洗衣機用了二十多年了，毛病真不少，可是媽媽還不肯換新的。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yéye niánjì dà le, bùdàn tǐlì bù hǎo, hái yǒu tóutòng, jiānbǎng tòng de máobìng. Wǒ jiā de xǐyījī yòng le èrshí duō nián le, máobìng zhēn bù shǎo, kěshì māma hái bù kěn huàn xīn de.
examples.english: My grandpa is old; not only is his physical strength poor, but he also has the problem of headaches and shoulder pain. Our washing machine has been used for over twenty years and has quite a few problems, but Mom still won't agree to replace it with a new one.

examples.chinese: 護理師告訴病人，得按三餐飯後的時間吃藥，才能快點恢復健康。
examples.pinyin: Hùlǐshī gàosu bìngrén, děi àn sāncān fànhòu de shíjiān chī yào, cái néng kuài diǎn huīfù jiànkāng.
examples.english: The nurse told the patient that he must take medicine according to the times after the three meals in order to recover his health quickly.

examples.chinese: 小陳認為頭痛是小事，況且最近忙得連休息的時間都不夠，所以不肯去看病。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Chén rènwéi tóutòng shì xiǎoshì, kuàngqiě zuìjìn máng de lián xiūxi de shíjiān dōu bù gòu, suǒyǐ bù kěn qù kànbìng.
examples.english: Xiǎo Chén thinks a headache is a small matter; furthermore, recently he has been so busy that he doesn't even have enough time to rest, so he refuses to see a doctor.

examples.chinese: 一般來說，小感冒只要多喝水、多休息就行了，不需要看病、吃藥。
examples.pinyin: Yībān lái shuō, xiǎo gǎnmào zhǐyào duō hē shuǐ, duō xiūxi jiù xíng le, bù xūyào kànbìng, chī yào.
examples.english: Generally speaking, for a minor cold, you just need to drink more water and rest more; you don't need to see a doctor or take medicine.

examples.chinese: 朋子看了好幾次醫生，吃了好幾個星期的藥，病總算好了。
examples.pinyin: Péngzǐ kàn le hǎo jǐ cì yīshēng, chī le hǎo jǐ gè xīngqī de yào, bìng zǒngsuàn hǎo le.
examples.english: Pengzi saw the doctor several times and took medicine for several weeks, and her illness finally got better.

examples.chinese: 醫生的工作是讓病人恢復健康，甚至把寶貴的生命救回來，所以我們應該尊敬醫生。
examples.pinyin: Yīshēng de gōngzuò shì ràng bìngrén huīfù jiànkāng, shènzhì bǎ bǎoguì de shēngmìng jiù huílái, suǒyǐ wǒmen yīnggāi zūnjìng yīshēng.
examples.english: A doctor's job is to help patients recover their health, and even to save precious life back, so we should respect doctors.

examples.chinese: 有一些病人不肯乖乖吃藥，護理師得有耐心，慢慢地跟他們講道理。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu yìxiē bìngrén bù kěn guāiguāi chī yào, hùlǐshī děi yǒu nàixīn, mànman de gēn tāmen jiǎng dàolǐ.
examples.english: Some patients refuse to take their medicine obediently, so nurses must have patience and slowly reason with them.

examples.chinese: 醫生說那個病人得住院，要是三天以內都沒發燒、頭也不痛了，就可以出院了。
examples.pinyin: Yīshēng shuō nàge bìngrén děi zhùyuàn, yàoshi sān tiān yǐnèi dōu méi fāshāo, tóu yě bú tòng le, jiù kěyǐ chūyuàn le.
examples.english: The doctor said that patient has to be hospitalized; if within three days he has no fever and his head no longer hurts, then he can be discharged.

examples.chinese: A:醫生說我應該多運動，少吃太鹹、太油的東西，這樣才不容易生病。 B:就是說嘛！我跟你說過好多次了，你怎麼不聽呢？
examples.pinyin: A: Yīshēng shuō wǒ yīnggāi duō yùndòng, shǎo chī tài xián, tài yóu de dōngxi, zhèyàng cái bù róngyì shēngbìng. B: Jiùshì shuō ma! Wǒ gēn nǐ shuō guò hǎo duō cì le, nǐ zěnme bù tīng ne?
examples.english: A: The doctor said I should exercise more and eat less of things that are too salty or too oily; this way it's not easy to get sick. B: Exactly! I've told you many times, why don't you listen?

examples.chinese: 我生病了，媽媽今天要帶我去醫院看醫生。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ shēngbìng le, māma jīntiān yào dài wǒ qù yīyuàn kàn yīshēng.
examples.english: I got sick; my mom is going to take me to the hospital to see a doctor today.

examples.chinese: 他上個禮拜生病了，現在還在咳嗽。
examples.pinyin: Tā shàng ge lǐbài shēngbìng le, xiànzài hái zài késou.
examples.english: He got sick last week, and he is still coughing now.

examples.chinese: A:聽說你弟弟生病了，他現在怎麼樣？ B:他好了，明天可以去學校了。
examples.pinyin: A: Tīngshuō nǐ dìdi shēngbìng le, tā xiànzài zěnmeyàng? B: Tā hǎo le, míngtiān kěyǐ qù xuéxiào le.
examples.english: A: I heard your younger brother got sick; how is he now? B: He has gotten well; he can go to school tomorrow.

examples.chinese: 我爸爸很健康，不常生病。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bàba hěn jiànkāng, bù cháng shēngbìng.
examples.english: My dad is very healthy and doesn't often get sick.

examples.chinese: 老師，我很健康，不常生病。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī, wǒ hěn jiànkāng, bù cháng shēngbìng.
examples.english: I am healthy and seldom get sick, teacher.

examples.chinese: 平常不生病的人也要注意。
examples.pinyin: Píngcháng bù shēngbìng de rén yě yào zhùyì.
examples.english: People who don’t get sick often should pay attention to their health as well.

examples.chinese: 媽媽生病時，小華給家人做飯、照顧弟弟妹妹，真是個懂事的孩子。
examples.pinyin: Māma shēngbìng shí, Xiǎohuá gěi jiārén zuòfàn, zhàogù dìdì mèimei, zhēn shì ge dǒngshì de háizi.
examples.english: When Mom was sick, Xiaohua cooked for the family and took care of his younger brother and sister; he is truly a sensible child.

examples.chinese: 跟大人比起來，小孩子的想法比較單純、天真，不會故意騙人。A:網友跟我借十萬塊錢，說他的家人生病住院了。 B:你太天真了，他是騙你的。
examples.pinyin: 1. Gēn dàrén bǐ qǐlái, xiǎoháizi de xiǎngfǎ bǐjiào dānchún, tiānzhēn, bú huì gùyì piàn rén. 2. A: Wǎngyǒu gēn wǒ jiè shí wàn kuài qián, shuō tā de jiārén shēngbìng zhùyuàn le. B: Nǐ tài tiānzhēn le, tā shì piàn nǐ de.
examples.english: 1. Compared with adults, children's thinking is simpler and more innocent; they won't deliberately deceive people. 2. A: An online friend borrowed a hundred thousand dollars from me, saying his family member was sick and hospitalized. B: You're too naive; he's deceiving you.

examples.chinese: 天氣變涼了，奶奶頭痛的毛病又犯了。
examples.pinyin: Tiānqì biàn liáng le, nǎinai tóutòng de máobìng yòu fàn le.
examples.english: The weather has turned cool, and Grandma's headache problem has occurred again.

examples.chinese: 有人以為身體沒什麼毛病就代表很健康，這樣的想法事實上不完全正確。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu rén yǐwéi shēntǐ méi shénme máobìng jiù dàibiǎo hěn jiànkāng, zhèyàng de xiǎngfǎ shìshíshàng bù wánquán zhèngquè.
examples.english: Some people think that if the body has no problems, it means being very healthy; in fact, this idea is not entirely correct.

items.wordHook: a 疒(sickness) takes hold on the 丙(third) floor → one bad case of 病(sickness).

examples.chinese: 結婚之前，那對情侶認真規劃了未來的生活，沒想到結婚一個月之後就離婚了。
examples.pinyin: Jiéhūn zhīqián, nà duì qínglǚ rènzhēn guīhuà le wèilái de shēnghuó, méi xiǎngdào jiéhūn yí ge yuè zhīhòu jiù líhūn le.
examples.english: Before getting married, that couple carefully planned their future life; unexpectedly, they divorced just one month after getting married.

examples.chinese: 那棟公寓自從三年前的一場大火之後，就不適合居住了。
examples.pinyin: Nà dòng gōngyù zìcóng sān nián qián de yī chǎng dàhuǒ zhīhòu, jiù bù shìhé jūzhù le.
examples.english: Since a big fire three years ago, that apartment building has not been suitable for residing in.

examples.chinese: 台灣有句著名的廣告台詞「心動不如馬上行動」，意思是當個人有了想法之後，光是想是沒用的，得立刻行動才行。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān yǒu jù zhùmíng de guǎnggào táicí “xīndòng bùrú mǎshàng xíngdòng”, yìsi shì dāng gèrén yǒu le xiǎngfǎ zhīhòu, guāng shì xiǎng shì méiyòng de, děi lìkè xíngdòng cái xíng.
examples.english: Taiwan has a famous advertising slogan, “Acting immediately is better than just being moved.” It means that after a person has an idea, merely thinking about it is useless; one must take action immediately.

examples.chinese: 我叔叔總是說工作很累想休息，可是休了假之後又覺得無聊。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ shūshu zǒngshì shuō gōngzuò hěn lèi xiǎng xiūxi, kěshì xiū le jià zhīhòu yòu juéde wúliáo.
examples.english: My uncle always says work is tiring and he wants to rest, but after taking a vacation, he feels bored again.

examples.chinese: 我的電腦無法上網，檢查之後才發現網路線沒有接著電腦。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de diànnǎo wúfǎ shàngwǎng, jiǎnchá zhīhòu cái fāxiàn wǎnglùxiàn méiyǒu jiēzhe diànnǎo.
examples.english: My computer can't get online; only after checking did I discover that the network cable was not connected to the computer.

examples.chinese: 一個人不管多有錢、多有地位，過世之後什麼也帶不走。
examples.pinyin: Yī ge rén bùguǎn duō yǒu qián, duō yǒu dìwèi, guòshì zhīhòu shénme yě dài bù zǒu.
examples.english: No matter how rich or how high-status a person is, after passing away, they can't take anything with them.

examples.chinese: 按照中國的傳統觀念，女人未嫁時得聽父親的話，嫁了人之後就得聽丈夫的。
examples.pinyin: Ànzhào Zhōngguó de chuántǒng guānniàn, nǚrén wèi jià shí děi tīng fùqīn de huà, jià le rén zhīhòu jiù děi tīng zhàngfu de.
examples.english: According to traditional Chinese concepts, before a woman marries she must listen to her father's words, and after she marries she must listen to her husband's.

examples.chinese: 你想參加這項長跑比賽的話，可以到網站報名，登記之後會有人跟你聯絡。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xiǎng cānjiā zhè xiàng chángpǎo bǐsài de huà, kěyǐ dào wǎngzhàn bàomíng, dēngjì zhīhòu huì yǒu rén gēn nǐ liánluò.
examples.english: If you want to participate in this long-distance race, you can sign up on the website; after you register, someone will contact you.

items.wordHook: Combining 之(of) and 後(after): 之後 means later.

examples.chinese: 媽媽把放在院子裡的一堆空瓶子、空罐子都扔了。今天的作業是寫一篇作文，可是我的腦子空空的，一個字也寫不出來。
examples.pinyin: Māma bǎ fàng zài yuànzi lǐ de yī duī kōng píngzi, kōng guànzi dōu rēng le. Jīntiān de zuòyè shì xiě yī piān zuòwén, kěshì wǒ de nǎozi kōngkōng de, yī gè zì yě xiě bù chūlái.
examples.english: Mom threw away all the empty bottles and empty cans that were placed in the yard. Today's homework is to write a composition, but my mind is completely empty; I can't write a single word.

examples.chinese: 公園附近的停車場還很空，你可以把車停到那裡去。
examples.pinyin: Gōngyuán fùjìn de tíngchēchǎng hái hěn kōng, nǐ kěyǐ bǎ chē tíng dào nàlǐ qù.
examples.english: The parking lot near the park is still very empty; you can park your car there.

examples.chinese: 這個改善空氣品質的計畫，已經實行三年了，還需要一段時間才能看到成果。
examples.pinyin: Zhège gǎishàn kōngqì pǐnzhí de jìhuà, yǐjīng shíxíng sān nián le, hái xūyào yī duàn shíjiān cái néng kàndào chéngguǒ.
examples.english: This plan to improve air quality has already been carried out for three years; it still needs some time before results can be seen.

examples.chinese: 這個地區不僅沒有地震、颱風，而且天氣好、空氣新鮮，生活環境安全又舒適。
examples.pinyin: Zhège dìqū bùjǐn méiyǒu dìzhèn, táifēng, érqiě tiānqì hǎo, kōngqì xīnxiān, shēnghuó huánjìng ānquán yòu shūshì.
examples.english: This area not only has no earthquakes or typhoons, but also has good weather and fresh air; the living environment is safe and comfortable.

examples.chinese: 天空突然下起了大雨，我的衣服和頭髮都濕了。
examples.pinyin: Tiānkōng tūrán xià qǐ le dà yǔ, wǒ de yīfu hé tóufa dōu shī le.
examples.english: Suddenly it started raining heavily, and my clothes and hair all got wet.

examples.chinese: 那家動物餐廳的空間很大，可以讓客人的小動物自由自在地活動。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā dòngwù cāntīng de kōngjiān hěn dà, kěyǐ ràng kèrén de xiǎo dòngwù zìyóuzìzài de huódòng.
examples.english: That animal restaurant has a lot of space, allowing guests' small pets to move around freely and fancy-free.

examples.chinese: 這個社區的周圍有山有水，空氣也很好，這樣的生活環境很適合退休的人。
examples.pinyin: Zhège shèqū de zhōuwéi yǒu shān yǒu shuǐ, kōngqì yě hěn hǎo, zhèyàng de shēnghuó huánjìng hěn shìhé tuìxiū de rén.
examples.english: The neighborhood of this community has mountains and water, and the air is also very good; such a living environment is very suitable for retired people.

examples.chinese: 那兩家便利商店同樣提供客人休息的座位，但是第二家的空間比第一家大多了。林媽媽總是給她的雙胞胎女兒穿同樣顏色、同樣大小的衣服。
examples.pinyin: Nà liǎng jiā biànlì shāngdiàn tóngyàng tígōng kèrén xiūxi de zuòwèi, dànshì dì èr jiā de kōngjiān bǐ dì yī jiā dà duō le. Lín māma zǒngshì gěi tā de shuāngbāotāi nǚ'ér chuān tóngyàng yánsè, tóngyàng dàxiǎo de yīfu.
examples.english: Those two convenience stores similarly provide seats for customers to rest, but the second store's space is much larger than the first's. Mrs. Lin always dresses her twin daughters in clothes of the same color and the same size.

examples.chinese: 這個城市的空氣變乾淨了，主要是因為有捷運以後，開車的人比以前少了。
examples.pinyin: Zhège chéngshì de kōngqì biàn gānjìng le, zhǔyào shì yīnwèi yǒu jiéyùn yǐhòu, kāichē de rén bǐ yǐqián shǎo le.
examples.english: The air in this city has become cleaner, mainly because after the MRT was built, fewer people drive than before.

examples.chinese: 我們學校的禮堂看起來空間不大，其實坐得下一千人。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen xuéxiào de lǐtáng kàn qǐlái kōngjiān bú dà, qíshí zuò de xià yì qiān rén.
examples.english: Our school's auditorium looks like it doesn't have much space, but actually it can seat a thousand people.

examples.chinese: 我同學送了我一張電影票，可是我沒有空去看。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ tóngxué sòng le wǒ yì zhāng diànyǐng piào, kěshì wǒ méiyǒu kòng qù kàn.
examples.english: My classmate gave me a movie ticket, but I don't have time to go see it.

examples.chinese: A:你現在有空嗎？ B:我現在要跟太太出去，晚上再給你打電話。
examples.pinyin: A: Nǐ xiànzài yǒu kòng ma? B: Wǒ xiànzài yào gēn tàitai chūqù, wǎnshàng zài gěi nǐ dǎ diànhuà.
examples.english: A: Are you free now? B: I'm going out with my wife now; I'll call you again in the evening.

examples.chinese: A:你什麼時候有空？要不要跟我去唱歌？ B:我今天下午有空。
examples.pinyin: A: Nǐ shénme shíhou yǒu kòng? Yào bú yào gēn wǒ qù chànggē? B: Wǒ jīntiān xiàwǔ yǒu kòng.
examples.english: A: When are you free? Do you want to go sing with me? B: I'm free this afternoon.

examples.chinese: 週末我有空，要約朋友一起去玩。
examples.pinyin: Zhōumò wǒ yǒu kòng, yào yuē péngyǒu yìqǐ qù wán.
examples.english: I'm free this weekend; I want to make an appointment with friends to go out and have fun together.

examples.chinese: 你這個週末有空嗎？ 我想跟你見面。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zhège zhōumò yǒu kòng ma? Wǒ xiǎng gēn nǐ jiànmiàn.
examples.english: Are you free this weekend? I want to meet with you.

examples.chinese: 他明天沒有空，不會來我們家。
examples.pinyin: Tā míngtiān méiyǒu kòng, bù huì lái wǒmen jiā.
examples.english: He is not free tomorrow and will not come to our house.

examples.chinese: 她明天也許有空，我們可以請她一起來喝咖啡。
examples.pinyin: Tā míngtiān yěxǔ yǒu kòng, wǒmen kěyǐ qǐng tā yìqǐ lái hē kāfēi.
examples.english: She might be free tomorrow; we can invite her to come have coffee together.

examples.chinese: 明天我有空，我想去買皮包。
examples.pinyin: Míngtiān wǒ yǒu kòng, wǒ xiǎng qù mǎi píbāo.
examples.english: Tomorrow I have free time; I want to go buy a wallet.

examples.chinese: 我明天有空，一定可以去。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ míngtiān yǒu kòng, yīdìng kěyǐ qù.
examples.english: I'm free tomorrow, so I can definitely go.

examples.chinese: A:你下午有空嗎？ B:我沒有空，我有中文課。
examples.pinyin: A: Nǐ xiàwǔ yǒu kòng ma? B: Wǒ méiyǒu kòng, wǒ yǒu Zhōngwén kè.
examples.english: A: Are you free this afternoon? B: I am not free; I have Chinese class.

examples.chinese: 我想去朋友家玩，可是沒有空。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng qù péngyǒu jiā wán, kěshì méi yǒukòng.
examples.english: I would like to go to my friend’s place, but I don’t have time.

examples.chinese: 你週末有空嗎？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zhōumò yǒukòng ma?
examples.english: Are you available this weekend?

examples.chinese: A:你下午有空嗎？ B:我沒有空，我有中文課。
examples.pinyin: A: Nǐ xiàwǔ yǒu kòng ma? B: Wǒ méiyǒu kòng, wǒ yǒu Zhōngwén kè.
examples.english: A: Are you free this afternoon? B: I am not free; I have Chinese class.

examples.chinese: 我朋友最近比較忙，別的時間他沒有空。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ péngyǒu zuìjìn bǐjiào máng, biéde shíjiān tā méi yǒukòng.
examples.english: My friend is busier lately; he isn’t available at other times.

examples.chinese: 你不要常常在家上網、看電腦、玩手機，應該去運動。明天我有空，我們可以一起去騎腳踏車。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ búyào chángcháng zài jiā shàngwǎng, kàn diànnǎo, wán shǒujī, yīnggāi qù yùndòng. Míngtiān wǒ yǒukòng, wǒmen kěyǐ yìqǐ qù qí jiǎotàchē.
examples.english: Don’t surf the internet, use the computer or play on the cell phone at home often. You should go exercise. I am available tomorrow. We can go ride bikes together.

examples.chinese: 妳星期六下午有空嗎？我們一起去喝下午茶，怎麼樣？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xīngqí liù xiàwǔ yǒukòng ma? Wǒmen yìqǐ qù hē xiàwǔ chá, zěnmeyàng?
examples.english: Are you available on Saturday afternoon? How about we have afternoon tea together?

examples.chinese: 那部電影沒有結局，是導演要留給觀眾想像的空間。
examples.pinyin: Nà bù diànyǐng méiyǒu jiéjú, shì dǎoyǎn yào liú gěi guānzhòng xiǎngxiàng de kōngjiān.
examples.english: That movie has no ending; it is that the director wanted to leave space for the audience's imagination.

examples.chinese: 夏天的夜晚，在院子裡吹著涼快的風，欣賞天空美麗的星星， 簡直就像在天堂一樣。
examples.pinyin: Xiàtiān de yèwǎn, zài yuànzi lǐ chuīzhe liángkuai de fēng, xīnshǎng tiānkōng měilì de xīngxing, jiǎnzhí jiù xiàng zài tiāntáng yīyàng.
examples.english: On a summer night, feeling the cool breeze in the yard and enjoying the beautiful stars in the sky, it's virtually like being in heaven.

examples.chinese: 只有圖畫，沒有文字的故事書 ，能夠留給兒童想像及思考的空間。
examples.pinyin: Zhǐyǒu túhuà, méiyǒu wénzì de gùshìshū, nénggòu liú gěi értóng xiǎngxiàng jí sīkǎo de kōngjiān.
examples.english: Storybooks with only pictures and no text can leave children room for imagination and thinking.

examples.chinese: 為了提高這座城市的文化水準，市長積極建設藝術表演中心、圖書館等公共空間。像機場、高鐵、捷運這類公共交通建設，都需要很多經費才能完成。
examples.pinyin: Wèile tígāo zhè zuò chéngshì de wénhuà shuǐzhǔn, shìzhǎng jījí jiànshè yìshù biǎoyǎn zhōngxīn, túshūguǎn děng gōnggòng kōngjiān. Xiàng jīchǎng, gāotiě, jiéyùn zhè lèi gōnggòng jiāotōng jiànshè, dōu xūyào hěn duō jīngfèi cái néng wánchéng.
examples.english: In order to raise the cultural level of this city, the mayor actively builds public spaces such as art performance centers and libraries. Public transportation construction such as airports, high-speed rail, and MRT requires a lot of funds to complete.

examples.chinese: 理論上，有空氣、水、食物就可以維持生命，但還是得看實際的情況。著名的科學家愛因斯坦（ Àiyīnsītǎn, Albert Einstein）發明了相對論（Theory of Relativity），這個理論對後來的科學研究產生了重大的影響。
examples.pinyin: Lǐlùn shàng, yǒu kōngqì, shuǐ, shíwù jiù kěyǐ wéichí shēngmìng, dàn háishì děi kàn shíjì de qíngkuàng. Zhùmíng de kēxuéjiā Àiyīnsītǎn fāmíng le xiāngduìlùn, zhège lǐlùn duì hòulái de kēxué yánjiū chǎnshēng le zhòngdà de yǐngxiǎng.
examples.english: In theory, with air, water, and food, life can be maintained, but it still depends on the actual situation. The famous scientist Albert Einstein developed the theory of relativity; this theory had a major impact on later scientific research.

items.wordHook: a 穴(cave) holds only 工(work) dust → empty and 空(hollow).

examples.chinese: 有人說，想了解一個人的真心，就得看他做的事、他說的話。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu rén shuō, xiǎng liǎojiě yí ge rén de zhēnxīn, jiù děi kàn tā zuò de shì, tā shuō de huà.
examples.english: Some people say that if you want to understand a person's sincerity, you have to look at what they do and what they say.

examples.chinese: A:我對何小姐是真心的，為什麼她一直不肯接受呢？ B:你應該更關心她、更體貼她，讓她知道你是真心愛她的。
examples.pinyin: A: Wǒ duì Hé xiǎojiě shì zhēnxīn de, wèishénme tā yìzhí bù kěn jiēshòu ne? B: Nǐ yīnggāi gèng guānxīn tā, gèng tǐtiē tā, ràng tā zhīdào nǐ shì zhēnxīn ài tā de.
examples.english: A: I am sincere toward Miss He; why does she keep refusing to accept me? B: You should care about her more and be more considerate of her, so she knows you truly love her.

examples.chinese: 如果真心愛對方，就不必在乎對方的樣子與生活背景。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ zhēnxīn ài duìfāng, jiù búbì zàihu duìfāng de yàngzi yǔ shēnghuó bèijǐng.
examples.english: If you truly love the other person, you don't need to care about their appearance and background.

examples.chinese: 想擁有一段百年好合的婚姻，除了真心的愛情之外，也應重視家庭的責任。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎng yǒngyǒu yī duàn bǎiniánhǎohé de hūnyīn, chúle zhēnxīn de àiqíng zhīwài, yě yīng zhòngshì jiātíng de zérèn.
examples.english: If you want to have a marriage that is a harmonious union forever, in addition to genuine love, you should also value family responsibility.

items.wordHook: Possessing 真(real) authenticity in 心(heart): 真心 means wholehearted, sincere.

examples.chinese: 為了在這場鋼琴演奏中有優秀的表現，小戴早晚不停地練習。
examples.pinyin: Wèile zài zhè chǎng gāngqín yǎnzòu zhōng yǒu yōuxiù de biǎoxiàn, Xiǎo Dài zǎowǎn bùtíng de liànxí.
examples.english: In order to have an excellent performance in this piano performance, Xiao Dai practices non-stop morning and evening.

examples.chinese: 我通常在家吃晚餐，只有好朋友邀請我吃飯，才會出門。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ tōngcháng zài jiā chī wǎncān, zhǐyǒu hǎo péngyǒu yāoqǐng wǒ chīfàn, cái huì chūmén.
examples.english: I usually eat dinner at home; only when a good friend invites me to eat do I go out.

examples.chinese: 新型筆電銷售時價格通常比較貴，有時倒不如買符合個人需要的舊型筆電。
examples.pinyin: Xīnxíng bǐdiàn xiāoshòu shí jiàgé tōngcháng bǐjiào guì, yǒushí dào bùrú mǎi fúhé gèrén xūyào de jiùxíng bǐdiàn.
examples.english: When new-model laptops are sold, the price is usually relatively expensive; sometimes it would be better to buy an old-model laptop that fits one's personal needs.

examples.chinese: 公司不斷推銷新型電子產品，通常是為了刺激客戶購買。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī bùduàn tuīxiāo xīnxíng diànzǐ chǎnpǐn, tōngcháng shì wèile cìjī kèhù gòumǎi.
examples.english: Companies constantly promote new types of electronic products, usually in order to stimulate customers to buy.

examples.chinese: 個性親切、大方，通常是從事服務業的最佳人才。
examples.pinyin: Gèxìng qīnqiè, dàfāng, tōngcháng shì cóngshì fúwùyè de zuìjiā réncái.
examples.english: People with a friendly and generous personality are usually the best talent for working in the service industry.

examples.chinese: 在觀光景點銷售紀念品，價格通常比一般商店高一些。
examples.pinyin: Zài guānguāng jǐngdiǎn xiāoshòu jìniànpǐn, jiàgé tōngcháng bǐ yībān shāngdiàn gāo yīxiē.
examples.english: Souvenirs sold at tourist attractions are usually a bit more expensive than those in regular stores.

examples.chinese: 錯誤通常來自粗心，因此無論事情大小都該用心處理。
examples.pinyin: Cuòwù tōngcháng láizì cūxīn, yīncǐ wúlùn shìqíng dàxiǎo dōu gāi yòngxīn chǔlǐ.
examples.english: Mistakes usually come from carelessness, so no matter how big or small the matter is, it should be handled with care.

examples.chinese: 通常第一名只有一位，但有時也會出現例外的情況。
examples.pinyin: Tōngcháng dì yī míng zhǐyǒu yī wèi, dàn yǒushí yě huì chūxiàn lìwài de qíngkuàng.
examples.english: Usually there is only one first place, but sometimes there are exceptions.

examples.chinese: 他手上有傷，醫師建議他三日以內不要碰水，以免感染。
examples.pinyin: Tā shǒu shàng yǒu shāng, yīshī jiànyì tā sān rì yǐnèi bùyào pèng shuǐ, yǐmiǎn gǎnrǎn.
examples.english: He has an injury on his hand, and the doctor advised him not to touch water for three days to avoid infection.

examples.chinese: 台灣這場地震的規模很大，使許多人受輕傷、重傷。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān zhè chǎng dìzhèn de guīmó hěn dà, shǐ xǔduō rén shòu qīngshāng, zhòngshāng.
examples.english: The scale of this earthquake in Taiwan was very large, causing many people to suffer minor and serious injuries.

examples.chinese: 像足球、籃球那樣激烈的運動，常讓運動員的小腿、手、腳受傷。
examples.pinyin: Xiàng zúqiú, lánqiú nàyàng jīliè de yùndòng, cháng ràng yùndòngyuán de xiǎotuǐ, shǒu, jiǎo shòushāng.
examples.english: Intense sports like soccer and basketball often cause athletes to injure their lower legs, hands, and feet.

examples.chinese: 那家工廠排出的黑煙不只氣味難聞，更可怕的是可能對肺部造成傷害。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā gōngchǎng pái chū de hēiyān bùzhǐ qìwèi nánwén, gèng kěpà de shì kěnéng duì fèibù zàochéng shānghài.
examples.english: The black smoke emitted by that factory not only smells bad, but even more frighteningly, it may cause harm to the lungs.

examples.chinese: 白天沙漠裡的沙子很燙(to be scalded)，要是光著腳，一定會被燙傷的。
examples.pinyin: Báitiān shāmò lǐ de shāzi hěn tàng, yàoshi guāngzhe jiǎo, yídìng huì bèi tàngshāng de.
examples.english: During the day, the sand in the desert is very hot; if you go barefoot, you will definitely get burned.

examples.chinese: 病人受傷的地方如果沒有好好處理，很容易會被感染。
examples.pinyin: Bìngrén shòushāng de dìfāng rúguǒ méiyǒu hǎohǎo chǔlǐ, hěn róngyì huì bèi gǎnrǎn.
examples.english: If the injured area of a patient is not properly treated, it can easily become infected.

examples.chinese: A:哎呀！我的手機掉到河裡了。 （shock or annoyance）B:那真是傷腦筋，看來你只好再買一支了。
examples.pinyin: A: Āiyā! Wǒ de shǒujī diào dào hé lǐ le. B: Nà zhēn shì shāng nǎojīn, kànlái nǐ zhǐhǎo zài mǎi yī zhī le.
examples.english: A: Oh no! My cell phone fell into the river. B: That's really a headache; it seems you'll have to buy another one.

examples.chinese: 所有令人傷腦筋的過程，都是為了使自己變成腦筋很好的人。
examples.pinyin: Suǒyǒu lìng rén shāng nǎojīn de guòchéng, dōu shì wèile shǐ zìjǐ biànchéng nǎojīn hěn hǎo de rén.
examples.english: All the brain-racking processes are for the purpose of making oneself a person with a good brain.

examples.chinese: 跟朋友飲酒是一件開心的事，不過飲酒過度卻可能傷害身體。
examples.pinyin: Gēn péngyǒu yǐn jiǔ shì yí jiàn kāixīn de shì, búguò yǐn jiǔ guòdù què kěnéng shānghài shēntǐ.
examples.english: Drinking alcohol with friends is a happy thing, but excessive drinking may harm your health.

examples.chinese: 手機雖然使生活更便利，但過度使用也可能傷害身心健康。人類過度的發展活動，已對動植物的生活環境造成嚴重破壞。
examples.pinyin: Shǒujī suīrán shǐ shēnghuó gèng biànlì, dàn guòdù shǐyòng yě kěnéng shānghài shēnxīn jiànkāng. Rénlèi guòdù de fāzhǎn huódòng, yǐ duì dòngzhíwù de shēnghuó huánjìng zàochéng yánzhòng pòhuài.
examples.english: Although mobile phones make life more convenient, excessive use may also harm physical and mental health. Humans' excessive development activities have already caused serious damage to the living environments of animals and plants.

examples.chinese: 這家醫院昨天半夜發生嚴重的火災，受傷的人數約有三十名。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā yīyuàn zuótiān bànyè fāshēng yánzhòng de huǒzāi, shòushāng de rénshù yuē yǒu sānshí míng.
examples.english: This hospital had a serious fire in the middle of the night yesterday; the number of people injured was about thirty.

examples.chinese: 路邊的攝影機錄到了房先生發生車禍的經過，讓警察順利抓到了害他受傷的人。
examples.pinyin: Lùbiān de shèyǐngjī lù dào le Fáng xiānsheng fāshēng chēhuò de jīngguò, ràng jǐngchá shùnlì zhuā dào le hài tā shòushāng de rén.
examples.english: The roadside camera recorded the course of Mr. Fang's car accident, allowing the police to smoothly catch the person who injured him.

examples.chinese: 這條路不平，有民眾貼了海報，請大家走路時要小心，以免受傷。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo lù bù píng, yǒu mínzhòng tiē le hǎibào, qǐng dàjiā zǒulù shí yào xiǎoxīn, yǐmiǎn shòushāng.
examples.english: This road is uneven, and some people have put up posters asking everyone to be careful when walking, in order to avoid getting hurt.

examples.chinese: 有人設計出地震的警告系統，減少了地震帶來的傷害，這樣的成就真是了不起。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu rén shèjì chū dìzhèn de jǐnggào xìtǒng, jiǎnshǎo le dìzhèn dàilái de shānghài, zhèyàng de chéngjiù zhēn shì liǎobuqǐ.
examples.english: Someone designed an earthquake warning system that reduced the damage caused by earthquakes; such an achievement is truly amazing.

examples.chinese: A:對不起，你的杯子被我打破了，我不是故意的。 B:沒關係！還好你沒受傷。
examples.pinyin: A: Duìbuqǐ, nǐ de bēizi bèi wǒ dǎpò le, wǒ bùshì gùyì de. B: Méi guānxi! Háohǎo nǐ méi shòushāng.
examples.english: A: Sorry, your cup was broken by me; I didn't do it on purpose. B: It's okay! Good thing you're not hurt.

examples.chinese: 黃先生的腳因為車禍受了很嚴重的傷，醫生建議他不要做太激烈的運動。這場網球比賽打得很激烈，已經打了五個小時了，還不知道誰輸誰贏。
examples.pinyin: Huáng xiānsheng de jiǎo yīnwèi chēhuò shòule hěn yánzhòng de shāng, yīshēng jiànyì tā búyào zuò tài jīliè de yùndòng. Zhè chǎng wǎngqiú bǐsài dǎ de hěn jīliè, yǐjīng dǎle wǔ ge xiǎoshí le, hái bù zhīdào shéi shū shéi yíng.
examples.english: Mr. Huang's foot was seriously injured in a car accident; the doctor advised him not to do overly intense exercise. This tennis match is being played very fiercely; it has already been played for five hours, and it is still unknown who will lose and who will win.

examples.chinese: 真正的朋友會幫助你、關心你，是絕對不會傷害你的。青少年常因為不了解而誤會父母的教育方式，或許等他們長大了，就能真正明白了。
examples.pinyin: Zhēnzhèng de péngyǒu huì bāngzhù nǐ, guānxīn nǐ, shì juéduì bù huì shānghài nǐ de. Qīngshàonián cháng yīnwèi bù liǎojiě ér wùhuì fùmǔ de jiàoyù fāngshì, huòxǔ děng tāmen zhǎngdà le, jiù néng zhēnzhèng míngbai le.
examples.english: True friends will help you and care about you; they will absolutely not hurt you. Teenagers often misunderstand their parents' way of education because they don't understand; perhaps when they grow up, they will truly understand.

examples.chinese: 不管是誰，如果失去了親愛的家人，一定會很傷心、很痛苦，這是很自然的。那個女演員演戲的樣子很自然，一點也不誇張，難怪導演很欣賞她。
examples.pinyin: Bùguǎn shì shéi, rúguǒ shīqù le qīn'ài de jiārén, yīdìng huì hěn shāngxīn, hěn tòngkǔ, zhè shì hěn zìrán de. Nàge nǚ yǎnyuán yǎnxì de yàngzi hěn zìrán, yīdiǎn yě bù kuāzhāng, nánguài dǎoyǎn hěn xīnshǎng tā.
examples.english: No matter who it is, if they lose a beloved family member, they will certainly be very sad and in great pain; this is very natural. That actress's acting is very natural, not exaggerated at all; no wonder the director appreciates her.

examples.chinese: 警察的工作主要是保護民眾，讓好人不被傷害。
examples.pinyin: Jǐngchá de gōngzuò zhǔyào shì bǎohù mínzhòng, ràng hǎorén bù bèi shānghài.
examples.english: The police's job is mainly to protect the public, so that good people are not hurt.

examples.chinese: 昨天晚上突然發生強烈地震，學校旁的那座橋塌了，還好沒人受傷。
examples.pinyin: Zuótiān wǎnshàng tūrán fāshēng qiángliè dìzhèn, xuéxiào páng de nà zuò qiáo tā le, hái hǎo méi rén shòushāng.
examples.english: Last night a strong earthquake suddenly occurred; the bridge beside the school collapsed, but fortunately no one was injured.

examples.chinese: 那位老先生走著走著，路旁的樹木突然倒了下來，他差一點就受傷了。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi lǎo xiānshēng zǒuzhe zǒuzhe, lù páng de shùmù tūrán dǎo le xiàlái, tā chà yīdiǎn jiù shòushāng le.
examples.english: That elderly gentleman was walking and walking, when suddenly the trees beside the road fell down; he was almost injured.

examples.chinese: 地震時要保護自己的安全，最重要的是避免頭部受傷。當地震發生時，我們應該怎麼做呢？
examples.pinyin: Dìzhèn shí yào bǎohù zìjǐ de ānquán, zuì zhòngyào de shì bìmiǎn tóubù shòushāng. Dāng dìzhèn fāshēng shí, wǒmen yīnggāi zěnme zuò ne?
examples.english: During an earthquake, you must protect your own safety; the most important thing is to avoid head injury. When an earthquake occurs, what should we do?

examples.chinese: 為了避免皮膚受傷，夏天出門時別忘了戴上帽子和太陽眼鏡。
examples.pinyin: Wèile bìmiǎn pífū shòushāng, xiàtiān chūmén shí bié wàng le dài shàng màozi hé tàiyáng yǎnjìng.
examples.english: To avoid skin injury, don't forget to put on a hat and sunglasses when going out in summer.

examples.chinese: 大人應該把刀子放在安全的地方，要不然小孩子碰了，可能會受傷。
examples.pinyin: Dàrén yīnggāi bǎ dāozi fàng zài ānquán de dìfāng, yàobùrán xiǎoháizi pèng le, kěnéng huì shòushāng.
examples.english: Adults should put knives in a safe place; otherwise, if children touch them, they might get hurt.

examples.chinese: 那個孩子受了傷，好像快死了，媽媽請醫生快點兒救救他。
examples.pinyin: Nàge háizi shòu le shāng, hǎoxiàng kuài sǐ le, māma qǐng yīshēng kuài diǎnr jiùjiu tā.
examples.english: That child got hurt and seemed close to dying; the mother asked the doctor to save him quickly.

examples.chinese: 聽到那首歌，讓李小姐哭得很傷心。
examples.pinyin: Tīngdào nà shǒu gē, ràng Lǐ xiǎojiě kū de hěn shāngxīn.
examples.english: Hearing that song made Miss Li cry very sadly.

examples.chinese: 王小姐的男朋友不愛她了，真的傷了她的心。
examples.pinyin: Wáng xiǎojiě de nánpéngyou bù ài tā le, zhēnde shāng le tā de xīn.
examples.english: Miss Wang's boyfriend doesn't love her anymore; it really broke her heart.

examples.chinese: 我不喜歡踢足球，因為腳很容易受傷。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bù xǐhuān tī zúqiú, yīnwèi jiǎo hěn róngyì shòushāng.
examples.english: I don't like playing soccer because feet get injured easily.

examples.chinese: 他因為打籃球的時候不小心，所以手受傷了。
examples.pinyin: Tā yīnwèi dǎ lánqiú de shíhòu bù xiǎoxīn, suǒyǐ shǒu shòushāng le.
examples.english: Because he was not careful when playing basketball, his hand got injured.

examples.chinese: 潮溼的居住環境不僅使家具不容易保養，並且更可能傷害人體健康。
examples.pinyin: Cháoshī de jūzhù huánjìng bùjǐn shǐ jiājù bù róngyì bǎoyǎng, bìngqiě gèng kěnéng shānghài réntǐ jiànkāng.
examples.english: A damp living environment not only makes it difficult to maintain furniture, but is also more likely to harm human health.

examples.chinese: 賽跑前要先做點兒運動，免得受傷。
examples.pinyin: Sàipǎo qián yào xiān zuò diǎnr yùndòng, miǎnde shòushāng.
examples.english: Before racing, you should do some exercise first, so as to avoid getting hurt.

items.wordHook: a 亻(person) and a 𠂉(lying person) rest under 昜(bright) sun → the fall will 傷(injure) him.

examples.chinese: 對學生來說，經常失眠可能降低學習效率。
examples.pinyin: Duì xuéshēng lái shuō, jīngcháng shīmián kěnéng jiàngdī xuéxí xiàolǜ.
examples.english: For students, frequent insomnia may reduce learning efficiency.

examples.chinese: 使用高度技術製造出來的工業生產機器，操作起來往往更有效率。
examples.pinyin: Shǐyòng gāodù jìshù zhìzào chūlái de gōngyè shēngchǎn jīqì, cāozuò qǐlái wǎngwǎng gèng yǒu xiàolǜ.
examples.english: Industrial production machines manufactured using highly advanced technology often operate more efficiently.

examples.chinese: 這次會議的效率真差，有人竟然沒看資料就來了，真是誇張。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì huìyì de xiàolǜ zhēn chà, yǒu rén jìngrán méi kàn zīliào jiù lái le, zhēn shì kuāzhāng.
examples.english: The efficiency of this meeting is really poor; someone surprisingly came without even looking at the materials—that's really outrageous.
